title: AI Meeting Assistant

Provider-agnostic LLM integration supporting seamless switching between OpenAI and local Ollama

title: LeapSQL-AI
description: Enterprise-grade Natural Language to SQL platform. Architected a secure 3-agent LangGraph pipeline (generator, evaluator, executor) with a 5-layer security model.
highlights: 3-Agent LangGraph Pipeline: Generator writes query, Evaluator verifies syntax/safety, Executor runs against DB
5-layer security model prevents destructive (DROP, DELETE, TRUNCATE) or malformed queries
Interactive schema inspection and contextual database indexing
Validates structured AI outputs using Pydantic contracts
